authority: Derived artist-layout reference for the current runtime; skin-authoring/AUTHORING_TEMPLATE_SPEC.json is authoritative for master-canvas crop geometry

coordinateConventions.compose: dp converted with runtime LocalDensity after WindowInsets.safeDrawing

referenceScenario.purpose: visual normalization only; not a device-density or inset guarantee

topGameplay.requiredTransparency: full-height gameplay-safe center [320,0,1600,1080], with tolerant alpha validation for new master-PNG builds
topGameplay.runtimeRule: Normal gameplay composites the complete authored bitmap above the game using alpha; artwork may overlap extreme left/right game edges
topGameplay.splitViewRule: the decorative top surround is not shown as the normal upper surround in Split View

touchSurface.rect: weighted remaining height above utilityBar; inset 12dp horizontal and 3dp vertical

lmb.nativeLabel: Standard only: Left; bottom-start with 16dp start and 12dp bottom padding
lmb.immersiveVisuals: skin artwork only; native label, overlay, separator, and position marker hidden

rmb.nativeLabel: Standard only: Right; bottom-end with 16dp end and 12dp bottom padding
rmb.immersiveVisuals: skin artwork only; native label, overlay, separator, and position marker hidden

utilityBar.rect: bottom row; 12dp horizontal and 4dp vertical padding; intrinsic minimum height 64dp

companion.immersiveVisuals: state-aware skin artwork; native text and chrome hidden

settings.immersiveVisuals: state-aware skin artwork; native text and chrome hidden

bottomSplit.adjustedInterfaceAspect: sourceAspect/(1-splitRatio), inverted for 90/270 degree source orientation
bottomSplit.trackpad: weighted remaining region; same padding, L/R formulas and utility bar as bottomTrackpad

immersivePanelFrame.runtimeRule: frames the live lower mirror; importer clears the center and runtime fits mirrored content inside the opening

bottomSplit.clippingContract: background renders below the runtime-sized mirror; no fixed source cutout is used and mirror pixels cannot be obscured

companion.pageBounds: Standard: 94% of safeDrawing width and height, centered. Immersive with exact art: full safeDrawing surface

header.immersiveAppearance: artwork supplies Companion title; native title/chrome hidden

primaryActions.geometryOwner: AdventurePad; artists decorate these fixed regions and never define coordinates
primaryActions.immersiveAppearance: dedicated state-aware artwork supplies labels and buttons; no native text, panels, or outlines
primaryActions.legacyFallback: when dedicated assets are absent, companion.background and the current native/transparent hit-target behavior remain unchanged

companion.futureExpansion: open area below primary action row reserved for future fixed action regions

notes.pageBounds: Standard: 94% centered page. Immersive with exact art: full surface
notes.header: fixed 72dp solid/light header with back and close in Immersive
notes.content: 16dp padding; 8dp gap; auto-save message plus OutlinedTextField weight(1), minLines=8
notes.keyboard: activity adjustResize and IME Done; visible editor height is runtime-derived

walkthrough.pageBounds: Standard: 94% centered page. Immersive with exact art: full surface
walkthrough.toolbar: 8dp horizontal/4dp vertical padding; back/close 48x48dp min; reader/search/contents/more are conditional intrinsic-width controls with 40dp min height
walkthrough.content: reader, contents and search are mutually dynamic; reading text scrolls with 16dp horizontal/12dp vertical padding

buttonAssets.pressedFallback: matching normal asset, then legacy L/R asset where applicable, then native rendering
buttonAssets.textRule: Standard supplies visible native labels. Immersive artwork supplies guide-required visual labels; Compose still owns semantics, localization metadata, accessibility, and interaction.

runtimeScaling.top.surround: FillBounds in Android View; Normal gameplay composites the complete RGBA bitmap above the game
runtimeScaling.bottom.split.background: Compose cover/crop beneath dynamic live mirror
runtimeScaling.companion.background: Compose cover/crop; full immersive Companion page or beneath 94% Standard page
runtimeScaling.notes.background: Compose cover/crop; full immersive Notes page or beneath 94% Standard page
runtimeScaling.walkthrough.background: Compose cover/crop; full immersive Walkthrough page or beneath 94% Standard page
runtimeScaling.statefulButtons: Compose nine-slice FillBounds; artwork state follows existing press state and does not own input
runtimeScaling.panel.frame: 64 px nine-slice frame around the live lower mirror in Immersive Split View; importer clears the center and runtime fits mirrored content inside the opening
